name: Extreme Prejudice
prerequisites: Seething Hatred, sneak attack +3d6, studied target class feature
benefit:
When you succeed at a sneak attack against a creature you selected as the target of your Seething Hatred feat, you use d8s to roll sneak attack damage instead of d6s.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 119
When you succeed at a sneak attack against a creature that is not the target of your Seething Hatred feat, you can spend 5 stamina points to treat the creature as if it were the target of your Seething Hatred for that attack.
flavor: Your hatred of a particular type of creature has honed your killer instinct.
